title: Bill Ford – General Atlantic (Manager Meetings, EP.03)
summary:
Bill is chairman and CEO of General Atlantic, a pioneer in growth equity investing founded back in 1980 by duty-free shoppers entrepreneur Chuck Feeney. Their conversation covers Bill's path to General Atlantic,
the key aspects of the firm's global growth equity strategy, and a host of rapid fire personal and
